00050 #define DLL_CALLCONV __stdcall
00051 // The following ifdef block is the standard way of creating macros which make exporting 
00052 // from a DLL simpler. All files within this DLL are compiled with the FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00053 // symbol defined on the command line. this symbol should not be defined on any project
00054 // that uses this DLL. This way any other project whose source files include this file see 
00055 // DLL_API functions as being imported from a DLL, wheras this DLL sees symbols
00056 // defined with this macro as being exported.
00057 #ifdef FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00058 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllexport)
00059 #else
00060 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllimport)
00061 #endif // FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00062 #endif // FREEIMAGE_LIB || !WIN32

00208         FID_CLUSTER6x6  = 3,    // Ordered clustered dot dithering (order 3 - 6x6 matrix)
00209         FID_CLUSTER8x8  = 4,    // Ordered clustered dot dithering (order 4 - 8x8 matrix)

00216 FI_ENUM(FREE_IMAGE_FILTER) {

00219         FILTER_BILINEAR   = 2,  // Bilinear filter
00220         FILTER_BSPLINE    = 3,  // 4th order (cubic) b-spline
00221         FILTER_CATMULLROM = 4,  // Catmull-Rom spline, Overhauser spline

00223 };

00254 FI_STRUCT(FreeImageIO) {

00256     FI_WriteProc write_proc;    // pointer to the function used to write data

00258     FI_TellProc  tell_proc;     // pointer to the function used to aquire the current position
